main.description: Records an on-chain tip sent to another account, optionally for a specific post. The transfer itself happens on-chain from the sender's wallet; the AppView only counts the tip after verifying the transaction.

recipient.description: The account that received the tip.

subject.description: The post being tipped, if any.

amount.description: Amount in the asset's smallest unit (eg wei), as a decimal integer string.

txHash.description: Transaction hash (EVM) or signature (Solana) of the transfer, on the chain given by the asset ID.

from.description: The sender's wallet. Should be a wallet linked to the sender's account.

to.description: The recipient's wallet. Must be a wallet linked to the recipient's account.
